captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a fixie track crankset. It consists of a large, circular, silver-grey chainring with pointed external gear teeth, mounted to a central black spindle. Extending in opposite directions from the central spindle are two black crank arms (left and right), each ending with a rectangular black pedal. The spindle and both crank arms rotate continuously around the main central axis, while each pedal is jointed to rotate continuously about its respective pedal axle.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a fixie track crankset. It should feature a large, silver-grey, multi-toothed circular chainring mounted to a central rotating spindle, with two black crank arms pointing in opposite directions. Each crank arm must have a rectangular black pedal attached that can rotate continuously about its axle.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by first creating a central spindle using cylinder primitives. The chainring is built by extruding a 2D sketch of a circle, adding teeth using a polar pattern, and subtracting mounting holes. The two crank arms are formed by lofting circles of different diameters along a line, then combining them with spherical ends. The pedals are modeled as rectangular blocks with subtracted hollow pockets. Continuous joints are then established to connect the spindle to the main assembly frame, the left and right crank arms to the spindle, and each pedal to its respective crank arm tip.
